component.name: Parallax Launcher
component.summary: One shelf for every game you own

description.p: Parallax Launcher gathers the games you already own into one library and launches them from there. It reads Steam's own installation records, so what it shows is what is actually on the disk.
Everything it knows stays on your computer. There is no account, nothing is uploaded, and the library is a plain text file you can read.

ul.li: Finds your installed Steam games across every drive
Launches them through Steam, or directly so the Steam window stays put
Fills in covers and banners from Steam's public artwork, with no key
Keeps your playtime, merging in the hours Steam already recorded
Per-game Proton and Wine settings, launch options, GameMode and MangoHud

description.p: Parallax can now be driven from a command line, so scripts and AI assistants can read the library, start games and edit entries.
The library is watched for changes made outside the window, and reloaded when they arrive.
How much room a game takes is shown beside its status.
Games can be sorted by the colour of their cover art.
A game's page shows how much room it takes on disk.
Adding a game now finds where it is installed by itself, and the button on an uninstalled game looks for it on this computer before asking Steam to download anything.
